pinned_source.title: Compressing Integer Sequences
pinned_source.author: Alistair Moffat
pinned_source.license: No source-code license asserted; clean-room algorithm implementation

mode_values.0: unary; parameter is 0; each value is limited to 0..31
mode_values.1: minimal binary over [0,U); parameter U is 2..1000000
mode_values.2: Elias C_gamma; parameter is 0; values are 0..1000000
mode_values.3: Elias C_delta; parameter is 0; values are 0..1000000
mode_values.4: Golomb direct-value code; parameter b is 1..128; values are 0..127
mode_values.5: Elias-Fano; parameter U is 2..4096; values are strictly increasing in [0,U)
mode_values.6: binary interpolative; parameter U is 2..4096; values are strictly increasing in [0,U)
mode_values.7: basic byte-aligned base-128 profile; parameter is 0; values are 0..1000000
mode_values.9: one-block PForDelta refinement; parameter k is 1..20; values are 0..1000000

output.encoding: Modes 0-6, 8, and 9 emit MSB-first packed code bits with zeroes in unused low bits of the final byte. Mode 7 emits byte-aligned base-128 code bytes verbatim. Simple-9 emits selector-plus-payload 32-bit words in big-endian byte order.
output.bit_modes: Modes 0-6, 8, and 9 concatenate code bits MSB-first and pack them into bytes; unused low bits of the final byte are zero.
output.byte_mode: Mode 7 emits its byte-aligned code bytes verbatim.

workspace.meaning: 4096-byte staged code stream, 4096-byte Elias-Fano bucket counts, and 512-byte packed output.
